name: advantages-spent-by-use
of: A mechanism by which exercising an advantage consumes a condition that made it advantageous, named with the condition spent, what it becomes, whether and by what it regenerates, and the observable mark that it was spent, and sorted by how much exercise spends it and what must register the exercise for the spend to occur: a first exercise that spends it whole, whatever its size, registered by the counterparty's memory alone; an exercise spent by a court's ruling, by the record's readers, by the target's forensics, by the counterparty's inference, or by the counterparty's decision to look; a position spent by any traceable exercise and regenerated by moving; a series whose pattern spends what no single exercise does; a body and a population that adapt on their own clocks; a counterparty, a principal, and an audience whose expectations become the price; and exercises registered by whoever fills or answers them, spent in proportion to their size or only past a scale that a rule-maker or an entrant can answer.
items: Never asked: an advantage that consists in a count of zero is spent whole by the first exercise, whatever its size, since 'I have never asked you for anything' is a sentence with one use, as the founder who telephones the customer's chief executive directly once, the supplier that has never invoked force majeure, the ally who calls in the debt from the war; the condition spent is the clean record, which becomes a count of one, so that the second ask is priced against the first rather than against the record; it does not regenerate, since no length of not asking again returns the count to zero, though a counterparty's turnover can lose the count; the mark is that the sentence can no longer be said, and a counterparty who hears 'I rarely ask' knows it has been said before; not status-conversions' Introducer's tab, where each introduction is billed to the introducer at a rate, since here the first exercise carries almost the whole price and the tenth almost none, and the bill is the asker's own.

Sword that drops the shield: an advantage held as a protection is spent when the protected matter is used as a weapon, as the defendant who pleads advice of counsel waives privilege over the advice and the file behind it, and the witness who testifies on a subject opens that subject to cross-examination; the condition spent is that the protected matter was never put in issue by its own holder, and it becomes discoverable material in the counterparty's hands; it does not regenerate for that subject, and the holder often learns it was spent only at the motion to compel, weeks after the pleading that spent it; the mark is the waiver ruling and the production that follows; not power-trades' Queen for a day, where the exclusivity of a fact is traded for immunity in a letter struck before the fact is spoken, since here nothing is traded and the spend is a side effect of an exercise the holder priced as free.

Ruling that prices the patent: an advantage held in the uncertainty of a right's scope is spent by testing it, as the unlitigated patent that licensees pay to avoid finding out about, and the untested termination clause the counterparty settles rather than construes; the condition spent is the uncertainty, which becomes a claim-construction order or a judgment, and even the win narrows, since a court that upholds a claim says what it covers and every future defendant reads the boundary; it does not regenerate for that right, though a continuation application can grow a new uncertain claim beside it; the mark is the order itself and a licensing rate that steps on the day it issues, up or down; not ghost-leverages' threat of suit under a statute already repealed, a dead power still obeyed, since here the power is live and the exercise reveals its exact size to everyone who will ever face it.

Novelty in the book: an advantage held in an opponent's unpreparedness is spent by one exercise in a venue that records, as the chess player's prepared novelty that enters every database the evening it is played and the trick play that is on the opposing staff's film by Monday; the condition spent is the idea's absence from the record, which becomes theory every future opponent has read; it does not regenerate for that idea, and the holder's stock regenerates only by preparing the next; the mark is the annotation in the database and, after it, a second showing that meets a prepared reply; the holder's control is the venue, since the same idea in an unrecorded game is not spent, which is why novelties are kept for the opponent and the round that matter; not Zero-day, spent by the target's own forensic reading, since here the target may never understand the idea and it is spent anyway by whoever reads the record.

Zero-day: an advantage held in a maker's ignorance of a flaw is spent by the exploit's use, because the exploit carries its own description onto the target's machine, where the target or its vendor can read it; the condition spent is the maker's ignorance, which becomes a patch, and the exploit's price falls from the price of an unknown flaw to the price of an unpatched population; it does not regenerate for that flaw, and the holder's stock regenerates only by finding another; the mark is the advisory and the patch date, and the trade's word for a spent exploit is burned; not Burned source, where the exercise spends the condition only if the action cannot be otherwise explained, since here the exercise is the description and no cover is available, only a target chosen for not looking.

Burned source: an advantage held in a stream of the counterparty's own communications is spent by any action that only the stream could explain, as the wartime convoy attacks based on decrypts that were preceded by a reconnaissance aircraft so the enemy could credit the aircraft, and the informant whose reports must not be acted on so exactly that only he could have told; the condition spent is the counterparty's belief that its channel is secure, which becomes a rekeyed cipher and a hunt for the leak; it does not regenerate for that source; the mark is the counterparty's procedure changing, which the holder sees as the stream going dark; the holder's control is explicability, so the exercise is rationed not by count but by whether a cover for each action exists, and the most valuable action is the one that cannot be covered; not Novelty in the book, spent by a record anyone can read, since here the register is the counterparty's own inference and an action that looks like luck leaves the source intact.

Image shown down: an advantage held in a counterparty's model of the holder is spent only if the exercise is revealed, as the tight player's bluff, which wins because of the image and destroys the image at showdown; the condition spent is the model, which becomes its opposite, a loose image that the counterparty can exploit and the holder can exploit in the other direction; it regenerates with a new table, or with time and a run of exercises that confirm the old model; the mark is the calls that come afterward; the holder can fold before the showdown and the counterparty's own fold keeps the image intact, so exercise without spend is available and the spend is made by the counterparty's decision to look; not Zero-day, where the revelation is in the target's hands, since here it is in the holder's hands until the last card.

Flaming datum: an advantage held in the counterparty's ignorance of where the holder is is spent by any exercise that can be traced, as the submarine whose torpedo hands the escorts a bearing, the sniper whose shot marks the hide, and the quiet acquirer whose first bid tells the market what it wants; the condition spent is the unknown position, which becomes a known one and a search centered on it; it regenerates by moving, at the cost of time and of the exposure the move itself risks, which is why the doctrine is one shot and relocate, and the acquirer, who cannot move, regenerates it only by bidding through a hand the market does not yet know is its own; the mark is the return fire, or in the market the price of everything the acquirer is now known to want; not Burned source, where what is spent is the counterparty's channel and no move restores it, since here the holder regenerates the condition by its own act.

Pattern in the visits: an advantage held in the unpredictability of an exercise is spent by no single exercise and by the series, as the surprise inspection that after four Tuesdays is expected on the fifth, the audit whose sampling rule has been inferred, the raid whose timing follows payroll; the condition spent is the target's inability to prepare, which becomes a schedule the target keeps better than the inspector does; it regenerates by randomization, which costs the holder its own planning and its staff's convenience; the mark is the site that is clean on inspection day and not the day after, a pattern the holder can see only by breaking its own; not Novelty in the book, spent by one recorded showing, since here each showing is free and the spend is a property of the sequence.

Tolerance: an advantage held in a receiver's naivety is spent by the dose, as the receptor that desensitizes under a repeated agonist so the same dose does less, and the audience that stops flinching at the alarm; the condition spent is the receiver's sensitivity, which becomes tolerance and, when the dose stops, an overshoot in the other direction; it regenerates with abstinence, on the receiver's clock and not the holder's; the mark is the escalating dose, which is the only number the holder can see; not Resistance bred, spent across a population by selection, since here the receiver is one body and the condition comes back if left alone; not stamina, since the thing spent is not the holder's supply but the target's response.

Resistance bred: an advantage over a population is spent by selection, as the antibiotic that leaves the survivors, the pesticide, and the phishing template that survives only in the inboxes trained on it; the condition spent is the population's susceptibility, which becomes a resistant population and a drug moved to the reserve list; it regenerates only where resistance carries a fitness cost and the exercise is withdrawn long enough, and sometimes not at all; the mark is the rising concentration needed for the same effect, measured across the population rather than the patient; the condition is a commons, so any holder's exercise spends every holder's condition and one holder's restraint preserves nothing, which is why stewardship is a rule and not a choice; not risk-rebound-effects' The antibiotic bequest, which names the successor risk the mitigation breeds, since here the point is the shape of the spend, that the condition is shared and the regeneration is on the pathogen's clock.

Exception cited back: an advantage held in discretion, the power to grant or refuse, is spent by the grant, because the grant is the next petitioner's precedent, as the end-of-quarter discount that teaches the buyer when to buy, the covenant breach waived three times that the borrower pleads as course of dealing, and the exception for one employee that becomes the policy; the condition spent is the unbound choice, which becomes a schedule the counterparty can read; it regenerates only by a distinguishing that costs the holder credibility or by a counterparty who has not seen the record; the mark is the anti-waiver clause, the paper by which lenders try to grant without spending, and the quarter-end spike in bookings; the spend reaches only the counterparty that saw the grant unless a carrier moves the record, a most-favored-nation clause, a union, a reporter; not deal-deaths' Concession-made option, where a concession reveals a need and manufactures the other side's alternative, since here the grant reveals nothing and binds by being repeated.

Lever that tags the hand: an advantage held in a counterparty's presumption that one would not use a power against it is spent by using it, as the employee who takes the counteroffer and is thereafter a flight risk, and the investor who blocks the sale under a protective provision and is thereafter the investor who blocks sales; the condition spent is the presumption of alignment, which becomes a tag; it regenerates only with the turnover of the people who remember; the mark is the succession plan started quietly, the reference call that goes badly, the allocation not offered; adds to power-trades' Veto sold as an improbability the exercise price, which is not the deal blocked but the deals not offered, paid in the market where the power was allocated; not status-conversions' Cashing out, where standing is sold for money, since here standing is spent as a side effect of an exercise that was not a sale.

Slack shown to the budget: an advantage held in a reserve nobody has counted is spent by the first draw on it that a principal sees, as the surge beds staffed on an ordinary Tuesday that appear in next year's bed count, the contingency line spent on the schedule that becomes next year's schedule, the engineer's hidden week of buffer that the manager learns of and removes; the condition spent is the reserve's invisibility, which becomes a line item; it regenerates only by building a new reserve above the new baseline and hiding it better; the mark is the next budget, where the reserve appears as capacity; not Tolerance, spent by a target's adaptation, since here the party that takes the reserve is the holder's own principal, and the exercise is spent not by an adversary but by being seen from above.

Tier above: an advantage held in a signal's rarity is spent by each use, as the priority flag, the urgent subject line, the superlative in the reference letter, and the honorific; the condition spent is the base rate against which the signal is read, which becomes a higher base rate and then decoration; it regenerates only by minting a rank above, the severity zero above the severity one, the new honorific, the word coined to replace the euphemism that has taken on its referent; the mark is the count of tiers, which records how many times the signal has been spent as a tree's rings record winters, an instance of clocks-that-are-not-clocks' Ratchet count; not risk-rebound-effects' The alarm fatigue, the sensitivity raised until the true alarm arrives pre-ignored, since here the spender is each sender and the regeneration is by a new tier that starts rare and is spent the same way.

Alpha spent by the trade: an advantage held in knowing where a price will go is spent by the trade that uses it, because the trade moves the price toward the knowledge, so the exercise realizes the advantage and consumes it in one motion and in proportion to its size; the condition spent is the price's ignorance, which becomes the price; it regenerates only with new information; the mark is the price impact, of which the part that eats the book refills as liquidity returns and the part the other side infers from the flow stays, and the trader who sees it slices the order and hides it in dark venues to spend the condition slowly enough to collect more of it; the register is the order flow itself, read by whoever fills it, so the spend needs no record, no forensics, and no cover, only a counterparty on the other side of the book, and the holder wants the spend, since the spend is the realization; not Umbrella that funds the entrant, spent past a threshold, since here every unit of exercise spends its own unit of condition and the holder chooses the rate.

Loophole with a name: an advantage held in a rule-maker's inattention is spent by exercise at a scale the rule-maker notices, as the tax structure that works until enough firms use it that the rule closing it carries the practice's name, as the anti-Morris-Trust rules carry the structure they ended, and the arbitrage across two regulators closed by a memorandum between them; the condition spent is inattention, which becomes a rule; it regenerates as the next gap, never as this one; the mark is the rule's name, and the practice taught afterward in the course on what used to work; not Umbrella that funds the entrant, where a rival is funded by the margin, since here no one competes for the gap and the responder is the party whose inattention was the condition.

Umbrella that funds the entrant: an advantage held in a sole position is spent by pricing to it, because the margin above the entrant's cost is what pays the entrant's qualification, as the incumbent supplier whose price makes the buyer's second source worth qualifying, the drug whose price funds the generic's patent challenge, and the sanctioned party's dependency, priced by the sanction into a payment rail of its own; the condition spent is the absence of a rival worth building, which becomes a rival; it regenerates rarely, and only by the rival's failure; the mark is the second name on the approved-vendor list and the volume it takes, which the incumbent will not recover by cutting price; the spend is a threshold, so exercise below the entrant's cost is free forever and exercise above it is fatal once; not walkaway-manufactures' Qualified on paper, the buyer's certificate, since here the certificate is read from the incumbent's side as the mark that the price went past the line.

source.register: Operator-grade and concrete: favors never asked, advice-of-counsel waivers, claim-construction orders, chess databases and game film, burned exploits, decrypt cover flights, poker showdowns, torpedo bearings, inspection schedules, receptor desensitization, antibiotic reserve lists, quarter-end discounts and anti-waiver clauses, counteroffers and blocked sales, surge beds and budget lines, severity tiers, order slicing and price impact, rules named after the structures they ended, second sources and generic challengers; drawn from litigation, competitive games, offensive security, wartime intelligence, submarine and sniper doctrine, regulatory inspection, pharmacology, epidemiology, enterprise sales and lending, employment and venture governance, hospital operations, incident management, trading, tax practice, and procurement.
source.mode: Analytical distinctions with observed illustrative cases, each simplified to one mechanism. Three items rest on readings the map cannot verify and say so: Never asked (that the first exercise carries almost the whole price regardless of size) is a folk claim stated as a mechanism; Umbrella that funds the entrant (that the incumbent's own margin is what pays for the entrant, rather than the entrant arriving on its own clock) is an analytical reading of price-umbrella cases, and its sanctions clause is speculative; Resistance bred's phishing case is an analogy, and its regeneration claim (a fitness cost of resistance) holds for some resistance genes and not others. The decrypt cover flights in Burned source draw on the documented wartime practice, simplified. No item is invented-world.
source.via: practice-deep-ideonomy; two Fable fieldwork breaths; independent Fable editorial review
boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy or a partition; a real raise, suit, campaign, or trade spends several of these conditions at once, and the list makes no claim to cover every kind.

The seriation is an itinerary of how much exercise spends the condition and what must register the exercise, not a ranking of value, danger, or reversibility; the map edges are conditional authored claims, and the convergence, passages, fork, and step they draw are interpretations.

The illustrative cases (advice-of-counsel waiver, decrypt cover flights, order slicing, anti-Morris-Trust rules, generic patent challenges, counteroffers) are simplified to expose one mechanism each and are not claims about specific transactions, cases, or operations; the exploit and intelligence items describe mechanisms, not practices to adopt.

Spending the advantage's own supply is out: money, stamina, ammunition, a one-use option, since what is consumed is the advantage and not a condition beside it; power-trades' Leased strike, a power spent by disuse, is out by direction, since here the spend is by exercise; and an advantage that becomes unattractive after use, the tactic that now embarrasses, is out unless a condition of its working was consumed. The exhaustion of a right by its first sale, in which the seller is paid and the buyer holds a unit the seller no longer controls, is in type and absent; it would sit beside Sword that drops the shield, spent whole by one exercise the holder priced as a gain.

status-conversions covers what one form of standing converts into and at what rate; power-trades covers what a power fetches when passed to another hand; this map covers only what an exercise consumes on the holder's own side without any conversion or trade, and each item adjacent to those maps says what it adds.

seriation.axis: The smallest exercise that registers, and what must register it for the spend to occur: from an ask of any size that spends the condition whole, registered by the counterparty's memory alone, through exercises spent by a court's ruling, by the record's readers, by the target's forensics, by the counterparty's inference, and by the counterparty's decision to look; then a position spent by any traceable exercise and regenerated by moving; then a series whose pattern spends what no single exercise does; then a body and a population that adapt on their own clocks; then a counterparty, a principal, and an audience whose expectations become the price; and at the end exercises registered by whoever fills or answers them, spent in proportion to their size, or only past a scale that a rule-maker or an entrant can answer.
seriation.note: An authored walk, not a scale of value or of danger, read as the smallest exercise that registers: an ask of any size at the start, one exercise in a recording venue or on a logging machine or in an inexplicable act or at a showdown, one traceable act, a series, a dose, a grant, a use, each unit of flow, and at the close an exercise past a scale that wakes a rule-maker or funds an entrant. Never asked opens it because an ask of any size spends the condition whole, and its register is the counterparty's memory alone, as its own turnover clause says, the same register as Lever that tags the hand and Exception cited back; the Fable critic corrected the author's opening claim of 'no register but the holder's own count', which the item's text contradicts. Umbrella that funds the entrant closes it because the register is a party the exercise itself summons, and every exercise below its cost is free forever. Novelty in the book → Zero-day is the consequential adjacency: both are spent by one exercise being read, but the novelty is read by whoever reads the record and the target may never understand it, while the exploit is read by the target's own forensics, so the holder rations one by choosing the venue and the other by choosing the target, and the question a counterparty asks changes from 'was this game published?' to 'does this machine keep logs?'. Zero-day → Burned source moves the register from the target's file system to the target's inference and gives the holder a cover for the first time; Burned source → Image shown down moves the decision to look into the counterparty's hands and gives the holder a fold. Flaming datum → Pattern in the visits is where the walk turns from one exercise to a series: the position regenerated by moving is spent again if the moves make a pattern. Tolerance → Resistance bred is a passage between levels, one body to a population, and the regeneration passes from the receiver's abstinence to the pathogen's fitness cost. Exception cited back, Lever that tags the hand, Slack shown to the budget, and Tier above are spent into expectations, of a counterparty, of a market, of the holder's own principal, of an audience, and the itinerary places the principal among them because the register is the same shape from above as from across. Tier above → Alpha spent by the trade is the hinge: both spend in proportion to use, but the tier's spend is registered in an audience's base rate that must be learned from the record, and the alpha's by whoever fills the order, reading the flow itself, with no record, no forensics, and no cover, so the walk ends where the register is the other side of the book and then where the register is a rule-maker or an entrant that the exercise had to be large enough to wake; the author's 'in the price itself, with no audience' was the same error as the opening and was corrected by the critic. Exception cited back's step edge back to Never asked reveals the two as mirrors, the grantor's and the asker's, registered in the same memory. One dimension the walk does not carry cuts across it: Resistance bred, Tier above, and Loophole with a name all spend a commons, where any holder's exercise spends every holder's condition, and only the first says so.

relations.to: Never asked: an advantage that consists in a count of zero is spent whole by the first exercise, whatever its size, since 'I have never asked you for anything' is a sentence with one use, as the founder who telephones the customer's chief executive directly once, the supplier that has never invoked force majeure, the ally who calls in the debt from the war; the condition spent is the clean record, which becomes a count of one, so that the second ask is priced against the first rather than against the record; it does not regenerate, since no length of not asking again returns the count to zero, though a counterparty's turnover can lose the count; the mark is that the sentence can no longer be said, and a counterparty who hears 'I rarely ask' knows it has been said before; not status-conversions' Introducer's tab, where each introduction is billed to the introducer at a rate, since here the first exercise carries almost the whole price and the tenth almost none, and the bill is the asker's own.
relations.label: If the holder has never granted, a refusal is free and reads as the rule, and the first grant spends 'never granted' the way the first ask spends 'never asked', whatever its size; so the decision before any grant is not how much to give but whether to become a party that gives.

relations.from: Ruling that prices the patent: an advantage held in the uncertainty of a right's scope is spent by testing it, as the unlitigated patent that licensees pay to avoid finding out about, and the untested termination clause the counterparty settles rather than construes; the condition spent is the uncertainty, which becomes a claim-construction order or a judgment, and even the win narrows, since a court that upholds a claim says what it covers and every future defendant reads the boundary; it does not regenerate for that right, though a continuation application can grow a new uncertain claim beside it; the mark is the order itself and a licensing rate that steps on the day it issues, up or down; not ghost-leverages' threat of suit under a statute already repealed, a dead power still obeyed, since here the power is live and the exercise reveals its exact size to everyone who will ever face it.
relations.to: Umbrella that funds the entrant: an advantage held in a sole position is spent by pricing to it, because the margin above the entrant's cost is what pays the entrant's qualification, as the incumbent supplier whose price makes the buyer's second source worth qualifying, the drug whose price funds the generic's patent challenge, and the sanctioned party's dependency, priced by the sanction into a payment rail of its own; the condition spent is the absence of a rival worth building, which becomes a rival; it regenerates rarely, and only by the rival's failure; the mark is the second name on the approved-vendor list and the volume it takes, which the incumbent will not recover by cutting price; the spend is a threshold, so exercise below the entrant's cost is free forever and exercise above it is fatal once; not walkaway-manufactures' Qualified on paper, the buyer's certificate, since here the certificate is read from the incumbent's side as the mark that the price went past the line.
relations.label: If the ruling upholds the claim narrowly, it tells the entrant exactly where the incumbent's price is free to it, so a win that was meant to hold the position draws the line the entrant designs to, and the uncertainty spent in court is the margin the umbrella can no longer keep.

exploration.first_question: By what mechanisms does exercising an advantage consume a condition that made it advantageous, what does the condition become, and does it come back?
exploration.changed_question: What must register the exercise for the condition to be spent, and can the holder ration the spend by choosing the register: is a quiet or a partial exercise available at all? Breath one assumed the counterparty registers the exercise by seeing, reading, inferring, or adapting to it. Pressing on the quarter-end discount showed the register can be the counterparty's expectation rather than its knowledge; pressing on the hidden buffer showed it can be the holder's own principal; and pressing on the informed trade showed an exercise registered by whoever fills it, spent in proportion to its size and by the holder's own wish, which is what made the threshold cases visible, the umbrella and the loophole, where the exercise is free until it is large enough to wake a party that then answers it.
exploration.new_member: Alpha spent by the trade: an advantage held in knowing where a price will go is spent by the trade that uses it, because the trade moves the price toward the knowledge, so the exercise realizes the advantage and consumes it in one motion and in proportion to its size; the condition spent is the price's ignorance, which becomes the price; it regenerates only with new information; the mark is the price impact, of which the part that eats the book refills as liquidity returns and the part the other side infers from the flow stays, and the trader who sees it slices the order and hides it in dark venues to spend the condition slowly enough to collect more of it; the register is the order flow itself, read by whoever fills it, so the spend needs no record, no forensics, and no cover, only a counterparty on the other side of the book, and the holder wants the spend, since the spend is the realization; not Umbrella that funds the entrant, spent past a threshold, since here every unit of exercise spends its own unit of condition and the holder chooses the rate.

priorities.item: Umbrella that funds the entrant: an advantage held in a sole position is spent by pricing to it, because the margin above the entrant's cost is what pays the entrant's qualification, as the incumbent supplier whose price makes the buyer's second source worth qualifying, the drug whose price funds the generic's patent challenge, and the sanctioned party's dependency, priced by the sanction into a payment rail of its own; the condition spent is the absence of a rival worth building, which becomes a rival; it regenerates rarely, and only by the rival's failure; the mark is the second name on the approved-vendor list and the volume it takes, which the incumbent will not recover by cutting price; the spend is a threshold, so exercise below the entrant's cost is free forever and exercise above it is fatal once; not walkaway-manufactures' Qualified on paper, the buyer's certificate, since here the certificate is read from the incumbent's side as the mark that the price went past the line.
priorities.why: Its carrier is public: brand drug prices, the dates of generic patent challenges, and patent expiries are all recorded, so the claim that the incumbent's own margin is what pays for the entrant, rather than the entrant arriving on the patent's clock, can be checked without anyone's cooperation.
priorities.next_question: For drugs with a single patent family, take the brand's price path in the years before the first generic challenge was filed and compare it with matched drugs that drew no challenge before expiry; if challenges follow price rises past a level rather than tracking expiry alone, the umbrella funded the entrant, and the level at which they arrive is the threshold this item claims.

priorities.item: Never asked: an advantage that consists in a count of zero is spent whole by the first exercise, whatever its size, since 'I have never asked you for anything' is a sentence with one use, as the founder who telephones the customer's chief executive directly once, the supplier that has never invoked force majeure, the ally who calls in the debt from the war; the condition spent is the clean record, which becomes a count of one, so that the second ask is priced against the first rather than against the record; it does not regenerate, since no length of not asking again returns the count to zero, though a counterparty's turnover can lose the count; the mark is that the sentence can no longer be said, and a counterparty who hears 'I rarely ask' knows it has been said before; not status-conversions' Introducer's tab, where each introduction is billed to the introducer at a rate, since here the first exercise carries almost the whole price and the tenth almost none, and the bill is the asker's own.
priorities.why: Low confidence that the first exercise carries almost the whole price regardless of its size, since the saying may describe a courtesy rather than a price; high generative promise, because if it holds, a class of advantages is priced by a step at one, and the operator's strategy is to remain a party that has never done the thing, never sued, never discounted, never invoked the clause, until the one exercise that is worth the whole record.
priorities.next_question: In long supplier relationships with recorded requests, compare what a first-ever concession request wins with what the second wins, holding the request's size fixed; the item predicts the first wins more per unit asked and costs more in the price of later requests, and a flat rate across requests would return this item to Introducer's tab's shape and remove it from the map.

gate.standard: declared type, close-neighbor discriminator, boundary case, and form inference
gate.independent_review: Fable critic: admitted after repairing the false register claim in Alpha spent by the trade and the edge built on it, completing Flaming datum's regeneration for its market case, and correcting the register reading at both endpoints of the of-sentence and the seriation; no item restated status-conversions or power-trades.

neighbors.left: Zero-day: an advantage held in a maker's ignorance of a flaw is spent by the exploit's use, because the exploit carries its own description onto the target's machine, where the target or its vendor can read it; the condition spent is the maker's ignorance, which becomes a patch, and the exploit's price falls from the price of an unknown flaw to the price of an unpatched population; it does not regenerate for that flaw, and the holder's stock regenerates only by finding another; the mark is the advisory and the patch date, and the trade's word for a spent exploit is burned; not Burned source, where the exercise spends the condition only if the action cannot be otherwise explained, since here the exercise is the description and no cover is available, only a target chosen for not looking.
neighbors.right: Burned source: an advantage held in a stream of the counterparty's own communications is spent by any action that only the stream could explain, as the wartime convoy attacks based on decrypts that were preceded by a reconnaissance aircraft so the enemy could credit the aircraft, and the informant whose reports must not be acted on so exactly that only he could have told; the condition spent is the counterparty's belief that its channel is secure, which becomes a rekeyed cipher and a hunt for the leak; it does not regenerate for that source; the mark is the counterparty's procedure changing, which the holder sees as the stream going dark; the holder's control is explicability, so the exercise is rationed not by count but by whether a cover for each action exists, and the most valuable action is the one that cannot be covered; not Novelty in the book, spent by a record anyone can read, since here the register is the counterparty's own inference and an action that looks like luck leaves the source intact.
neighbors.separating_case: One holder uses the same exploit against two targets on the same day. The first target images its disks after every incident, so the exploit is read from the image and patched within the month whether the intrusion took anything or not: spent by use. The second target keeps no logs, and the intrusion's only effect is a file deleted; if the deletion could be a disk failure, the flaw stays unknown and the holder can use it again, and if the deletion is of the one file only the holder wanted, the target infers a channel and hunts for it though it never reads the exploit: spent by inexplicability. A holder who cannot tell which target it faces prices the exploit as spent; one who can chooses the blind target and then spends by cover, which is why the two are one move apart on the map and two stops apart on the walk.

checks.boundary_case: The strike not run in twenty years, which returns at expiry as a threat the employer no longer believes, is a tempting nonmember and is out: it is spent by disuse, and power-trades' Leased strike carries it. Walk on record in walkaway-manufactures is the same power in the other direction, an advantage that regenerates by being exercised, and it too is out. The fence is direction: what exercise consumes is in, what exercise builds or disuse consumes is out. The one-use option, spent by exercise by construction, is out on the other side, since nothing beyond the option's own text is consumed; Never asked is in on exactly that contrast, since the ask is not one-use by any text and the count is a condition the record keeps beside it.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a convergence the walk conceals: Pattern in the visits is one stop on the itinerary, but two rationing strategies drain into it, the relocation that regenerates a Flaming datum and the slicing that spends Alpha slowly, so the two ways a holder has of spending a condition a little at a time are the two ways of making the series that spends it whole. It shows a passage between levels at Tolerance → Resistance bred, where the regeneration passes from the receiver's abstinence to the pathogen's fitness cost and the holder's restraint stops being worth anything alone. It shows a fork at Image shown down, whose two arms are whether the exercise works unseen: if it does the holder keeps a fold, and if the counterparty must see it to be moved the spend is automatic and becomes a Lever that tags the hand. It shows a step at Exception cited back → Never asked, where the first grant is priced like the first ask, so a walk that ends with exercises free below a threshold begins with an exercise for which any size is the threshold. And it shows an inversion at Ruling that prices the patent → Umbrella that funds the entrant, where the win that was meant to hold the position is what tells the entrant where the position ends.
checks.target_preserved: Judged by the Fable critic in a fresh context: each item names a distinct spend, the condition, what it becomes, whether and by what it regenerates, and the mark; the critic tried to collapse Never asked into Exception cited back and could not, since one is the asker's record and the other the grantor's discretion, separated Never asked from Lever that tags the hand on the same raise (a count of restraint against a model of alignment, priced on the holder's next ask against the counterparty's next offer), and kept the strange members (an advantage spent whole by a count going from zero to one, a reserve spent by the holder's own principal seeing it, a win that draws the entrant's line, a spend the holder wants because the spend is the realization) as mechanisms rather than domesticating them into signaling or into cost.
